evidence: related.tex:95-101 cites K8sAutoscalers (project docs, not in papers_cited). The characterization matches canonical, well-documented autoscaler semantics: Kubernetes HPA scales on an aggregate resource-utilization or custom/external metric; KEDA generalizes the trigger to event sources (still one configured scaler); Knative KPA regulates on request concurrency / RPS. In their default model-serving configurations each observes a single aggregate signal derived from the one request stream, none decomposes demand per pool/modality. No contradicting evidence found.
